verdict.rationale: Drive API scopes explicitly allow apps to 'create and delete' files and manage permissions, giving users/developers programmatic control over deletion of their own data, but the evidence pack has no documentation on retention periods, bulk/automatic deletion policies, or AI-specific data-use/retention controls (e.g., opting out of AI training, data lifecycle policies). missing for 10: explicit retention policy docs, AI training data opt-out/deletion guarantees, audit trail for deletion, independent confirmation of deletion behavior.
